question: In which year was Dattopant Thengadi National Board for Workers Education and Development established?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1958**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **1958** is the year when Dattopant Thengadi National Board for Workers Education and Development was established.
 
• The board was originally established to promote education and development among workers in India.
 
• The organization aims to empower workers through education, thereby enhancing their overall development and contributing to national productivity.
 
• It provides training and educational programs to workers to improve their skills, knowledge, and awareness of their rights and responsibilities.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The board was named after **Dattopant Thengadi**, a prominent Indian trade union leader and social activist.
 
• The establishment of the board reflects the commitment of the Indian government to the education and welfare of workers.
 
• Over the years, the board has played a significant role in promoting workers' education and has adapted its programs to meet the changing needs of the workforce.
